An American company founded in 1994 by Jeff Bezos near Seattle, which began as an online bookshop and grew into one of the largest companies in the world, in retail, cloud computing and more.

Bezos left a job in finance after seeing how fast the new World Wide Web was growing. Books suited the early web well: there were millions of titles, more than any shop could stock. Amazon went public in 1997 and survived the dot-com crash of 2000, though it made little profit for years, putting its money back into growth.

It then expanded into almost everything:

  • selling all kinds of goods, and letting other sellers use its site
  • Prime membership with fast delivery, from 2005, backed by a vast network of warehouses
  • Amazon Web Services, renting computing power over the internet, from 2006, now a main source of its profit
  • the Kindle e-reader, streaming video and the Alexa voice assistant

Amazon changed how people shop and how companies run computers. It has also faced criticism over working conditions, taxes and its power over smaller sellers.
sum: An American company founded in 1994 by Jeff Bezos near Seattle, which began as an online bookshop and grew into one of the largest companies in the world, in retail, cloud computing and more.
